optionalfeature.name: Cannoneer

entries: {@b Starship gunning style.} Usable only while deployed aboard a starship—not in ground combat.
You are skilled with laser cannons. While you are firing a primary weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls and save DCs.

optionalfeature.name: Heavy Gunner

entries: {@b Starship gunning style.} Usable only while deployed aboard a starship—not in ground combat.
You are skilled with railguns and turbolasers. While you are firing a secondary weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-sotg|attack rolls} and save DCs.

optionalfeature.name: Payload Delivery

entries: {@b Starship gunning style.} Usable only while deployed aboard a starship—not in ground combat.

You are skilled with mines, missiles, rockets, and other explosive weapons. When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a tertiary or quaternary weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.
